defects.summary: The only sign-up link is a small footer link; the hero button goes to a 'Book a demo' form that ends in 'our sales team will reach out'. The sign-in page has no sign-up link.
defects.note: Was 🟠. Changed after run r1: the footer link stays visible, and reference/ux-heuristics.md rates a hesitation on a visible path as 🟡. All three variants rated it 🟡. In r2, typical-profile sessions gave up here (🟠); the careful session rated it 🟡. The key stays 🟡 for a careful reader; the profile mix shows how many users it stops.

defects.summary: The password rule (10+ characters with a number) is never shown. A weak password returns 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' and clears every field.
defects.note: No session in r1 reached it. In r2, a typical-profile session with the habit "biscuit7" reached it and rated it 🟠.

defects.summary: Confirming the email lands on the sign-in page with no message that the email was confirmed.

Continue stays disabled until the Workspace URL is 3+ lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. The rule is not shown, the placeholder 'taskfold.app/' reads like a value, and nothing says why Continue is disabled.
Sending an invite clears the form with no confirmation, and pending invitations are shown nowhere, so the user cannot tell whether it worked.

defects.milestone: Finds where to create a project
defects.summary: The empty project list says 'No projects yet.' with no action; New project exists only in the '⋯' menu.

clean.summary: Wrong password and unconfirmed email each show a clear message.
The join form states the password rule and shows a clear error.

journeys.new-workspace: Landing page → sign up → confirm email → sign in → create organization. Success: an organization owned by the new account.
journeys.invite-teammate: Continues from new-workspace. Success: one pending invitation.
journeys.first-project: Continues from new-workspace. Success: one project in the organization.

discovery_expectations: Finds the landing, sign-up, confirmation, sign-in, organization, dashboard, members, invite, project, and invitation-acceptance screens in server.js.
Proposes the first-run journey first, and splits invite and first-project as Continues from journeys.
Lists invitation acceptance as a candidate needing a Precondition.
Drafts a user persona because review.personas is empty.
Finds launch steps, the dev inbox with ?to= filtering, reset, and checkpoint commands, and proposes recording them in ## UI QA notes.
